charts.title: TOI-5489 b: orbits around TOI-5489
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5489's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5489 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gomez Barrientos et al. 2026 (2026AJ....171...99G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GOMEZ_BARRIENTOS_ET_AL_2026): P 3.15222 d

charts.title: TOI-5489 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5489 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 468983280, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 20 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 6-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 7 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
